name: Peñacaballera (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of red, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Peñacaballera (leaves and rocks on green and white).
history: The municipal flag is square, as befits municipal ensigns, with three stripes perpendicular to the hoist and the arms; the colours are those described in the project.

features.role: Peñacaballera arms — leaves and rocks on green and white
small black square near the lower hoist
